claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows only partial tank text 'Kawasa...'; no model name 'ZZR' is visible to confirm or deny the specific model.
No photographic evidence can confirm or deny a seller's personal reason for selling.
No video or photo shows the engine running, exhaust smoke, or any indication of operational status.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or may run poorly
risks.proof: Video of key turn, engine start, idle, and revving with audible sound

risks.risk: True mileage unknown or odometer tampered
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit close-up photo of the odometer reading

risks.risk: No valid title, registration, or proof of ownership
risks.proof: Photo of registration papers/particulars matching seller's name and frame number

risks.risk: Frame or engine number may not match documents or could be altered
risks.proof: Close-up photo of stamped frame/engine number

risks.risk: Front tire and front brake condition unknown
risks.proof: Clear photo of front wheel, tire tread, and brake caliper

risks.risk: Hidden body damage, rust, or accident repair not visible in close-up shots
risks.proof: Full-length photos from both sides, front, and rear in good light

risks.risk: Battery and electrical system (lights, horn, indicators) may be faulty
risks.proof: Short video showing headlight, taillight, turn signals, and horn functioning

risks.risk: Exact model (ZZR variant/year) unconfirmed, affecting value tier
risks.proof: Clear photo of full tank badge/model sticker or VIN decode

proof_requests: Video of engine starting, idling, and revving
Photo of registration/title documents and frame/engine number
Full-body photos from all sides in good lighting
Photo of front wheel, tire, and brake
Video showing lights, indicators, and horn working
Clear photo of model badge or VIN plate confirming ZZR designation
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Kawasaki motorcycle, so it can be priced, but unverified running condition, unconfirmed model, and missing documentation mean it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
